text.text: Armor for a wolf, built from Tinkers materials: chestplate plating, maille and two large plates. The plating decides armour/durability (armour is doubled), the maille adds toughness, and the two large plates make it require the Tinkers anvil.
Right-click a wolf with the armor to put it on (works on wild wolves too); use shears to take it off.

properties: 4 parts: chestplate plating / maille / 2 large plates
Fits a wolf, not a player
